title: The plan and the board on your phone
description: The Desktop CNC Mill's plan on a phone: the milestones and their criteria, the schedule, the board column by column, and what needs you.

steps.say: The mill's plan on a phone: how far it has got, how many tasks are done, and how many are late.
Each milestone shows whether it is met. The first two reviews are, and the critical design review is a quarter of the way there.
The schedule lists every phase and task with its dates and progress, in order.
The board shows one column at a time.
Move along to the work in progress: the detailed design, the verification plan and the long-lead parts.
And Home lists what needs you across every project, so a review or a failing test is never more than a tap away.
